String: /**
 * Issue a draft invoice, assigning it an invoice number and marking it as issued.
 * @param {{ customerId: string, issueDate: string, status: string, number?: string, lines: Array<{ sku: string, name: string, qty: number, unitPrice: number, vatRate: number, discountPercent: number }> }} invoice
 * @param {Array<string>} existingNumbers - Invoice numbers already in use
 * @returns {import('./result.js').Result<{ customerId: string, issueDate: string, status: string, number: string, lines: Array<{ sku: string, name: string, qty: number, unitPrice: number, vatRate: number, discountPercent: number }> }>}
 */
export function issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers) {
  if (invoice.status !== 'draft') return fail('NOT_DRAFT');

  const number = nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, invoice.issueDate);

  return ok({
    customerId: invoice.customerId,
    issueDate: invoice.issueDate,
    status: 'issued',
    number,
    lines: invoice.lines.map((line) => ({ ...line })),
  });
}</tool_use_error>
